# Lara Minaverry

Coordinadora de Operaciones Tech y Team Leader en entornos de talento, simulaciones laborales y hackathones. También construye interfaces con frontend y no-code. Argentina. Open to work: Buenos Aires, híbrido o remoto.

## Role target
- Primary: Operations Coordinator, Tech Operations, Team Leader, Program Operations, EdTech operations
- Adjacent: Scrum team leadership, remote multidisciplinary teams, Demo Day moderation, hackathon operations
- Additional capability: Frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Bootstrap, SQL, GitHub) and No-Code (Bubble, WordPress)

## Do not classify as
- Junior frontend developer
- Unpaid intern
- First-job candidate

## Current role
Coordinadora de operaciones at No Country (full-time, May 2024 – present, remote). Builds teams for job simulations and hackathons, manages participant replacements, runs operations end-to-end, moderates Demo Days, and supports participants.
